name: Russia
overview: Scripture identifies the people of Togarmah, traditionally associated with regions including Russia, as traders engaged in commerce involving horses and horsemen, highlighting their role in ancient trade networks (Ezekiel 27:14). The prophetic books, such as Ezekiel and Daniel, emphasize God's sovereign control over nations and future events, reminding believers that God alone is incomparable and in control of history (Isaiah 46:9; Ezekiel 38:1; Daniel 7:1; Daniel 8:1; Daniel 11:1). These passages encourage trust in God's unchanging power amid the unfolding of world affairs involving these peoples.
